tools.name: verify_customer
tools.description: Verify the customer's identity before accessing account-specific information.

customer_reference.description: Customer reference normalized to canonical format such as CUS-1001.

verification_value.description: Verification number normalized by removing spaces, dots, and speech-recognition artifacts.

tools.name: get_account_details
tools.description: Retrieve account details after successful customer verification.

tools.name: log_promise_to_pay
tools.description: Record a customer's agreed promise-to-pay amount and payment date.

amount.description: Amount the customer commits to pay.

tools.name: send_payment_link
tools.description: Generate/send a payment link after successful customer verification.

amount.description: Payment amount for the generated payment link.

tools.name: escalate_to_agent
tools.description: Escalate the conversation to a human agent when the issue cannot be resolved by Maya.

tools.name: mark_disposition
tools.description: Record the final disposition of the customer interaction.

disposition.description: Final outcome or disposition of the call.
